name: Harmony One, the test setup composed onto Logitech's compile
description: todo-compile-one 1.3, the spare Harmony One as written in findings section 403 (screen light 20 s, no Remote Assistant at start): the test setup's seven devices and five activities composed by our own code onto Logitech's compile of two devices. What it answers: whether every activity starts the devices the file says, in its order, whether the screen buttons send, and whether device mode and Off work. Predicted from the written file, starting from everything off: TV kijken switches on the LG, the KPN box and the Denon, the LG to HDMI 1 and the Denon to CBL/SAT, about 10 s after the LG's power for the LG's own delay; Film kijken the Plasma, Kodi and the Denon, the Plasma to HDMI 2 and the Denon to Media Player; Muziek Kodi and the Sony HT, Function on the Sony three times; Kodi kijken the LG, Kodi and the Switch, the LG to HDMI 3 and the Switch to Input 2; Plasma kijken the Plasma and the KPN box, the Plasma to HDMI 1. Going from one activity to the next switches off what the next one does not use, except the KPN box, which stays on. Keep the remote pointed at the Flirc throughout, and please write in each step's note what you saw and heard, also when it is what the step expects.

steps.instruction: Press Off and wait until the remote is quiet, so everything starts from off. Expect the activity list, 'Options' and 'Devices' below the screen: page 1 TV kijken, Film kijken, Muziek. Mark

Touch TV kijken. Expect 'Starting TV kijken', then the LG's power, the KPN box's power and the Denon's power, the LG to HDMI 1 and the Denon to CBL/SAT. Then the TV kijken screen: Devices, Teletext, DVR. Note what the monitor heard and in which order. Mark when it settles
Press Volume up once, then Channel up once. Expect the Denon's volume up, then the KPN box's channel up. Touch Teletext, then DVR. Expect the KPN box's Teletext and DVR. Mark

Press the Activities key and touch Film kijken. Expect the Plasma's power, Kodi's power, the Plasma to HDMI 2 and the Denon to Media Player, and the LG switched off; nothing to the KPN box. Then the screen: Devices, Aspect, 3D, Sleep. Touch Aspect. Expect the Plasma's Aspect. Mark when it settles

Press the Activities key and touch Muziek. Expect Kodi kept on, the Sony HT's power and its Function three times, the Plasma and the Denon switched off. Then the screen: Devices, Sleep. Press Volume up once. Expect the Sony HT's volume up. Mark when it settles

Press the Activities key, turn to page 2 with the arrow beside the screen and touch Kodi kijken. Expect the LG's power, the Switch's power, the LG to HDMI 3 and the Switch to Input 2, the Sony HT switched off. Then the screen: Devices, Sleep. Press Volume up once. Expect the LG's volume up. Mark when it settles

Press the Activities key, page 2, touch Plasma kijken. Expect the Plasma's power, the KPN box's power, the Plasma to HDMI 1, and the LG, Kodi and the Switch switched off. Then the screen: Devices, Teletext, DVR, Aspect, Radio. Touch Radio. Expect the KPN box's 1, a pause of about 2 s, then its 2. Mark when it settles

On the Plasma kijken screen touch Devices. Expect the device list, three a page: Denon, LG, Plasma; then KPN, Kodi, Switch; then Sony HT. Touch KPN. Expect its own pages with 'Activities' and 'Devices' below the screen. Touch one of its commands and note which, and what the monitor heard. Then press the key below the screen labelled 'Current Activity' or 'Activities' and note where it goes. Mark
Press Off. Expect power off codes for what Plasma kijken switched on, the Plasma and the KPN box, then the activity list. Note which devices the monitor heard. Mark when it is quiet
